title: Civil - Project Manager/ Senior Project Manager/ Project Head / DGM
description:
Role & responsibilities The Senior professional will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of housing construction projects within the real estate sector. This includes project management, design and planning, structural analysis, site management, quality control, cost estimation and budgeting, risk management, and team leadership. 
 Responsibilities 
 1. Project Management: - Lead and manage housing construction projects from initiation to completion. - Develop project plans, schedules, and budgets, and ensure adherence to them. - Coordinate with internal teams, external contractors, and subcontractors to ensure project milestones are achieved on time and within budget. 
 2. Design and Planning: - Collaborate with architects, designers, and other engineers to develop comprehensive plans and blueprints for residential buildings. - Ensure designs are innovative, cost-effective, and compliant with relevant building codes and regulations. 
 3. Structural Analysis: - Conduct thorough structural analysis to ensure the integrity and safety of residential structures. - Utilize engineering software and tools to evaluate structural designs and propose necessary modifications. 
 4. Site Management: - Supervise construction sites, ensuring adherence to safety protocols and quality standards. - Monitor construction progress, resolve any issues or conflicts that arise, and ensure efficient utilization of resources. 
 5. Quality Control: - Implement rigorous quality control measures to maintain high construction standards. - Inspect construction materials, methods, and workmanship to identify and address any deficiencies. 
 6. Cost Estimation and Budgeting: - Estimate project costs accurately and prepare detailed budgets. - Monitor project expenses and identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality or safety. 
 7. Risk Management: - Identify potential risks and uncertainties associated with construction projects and develop strategies to mitigate them. - Proactively address any issues that may arise during the construction process to minimize disruption and delays. 
 8. Team Leadership: - Lead a team of engineers, drafters, and technicians, providing guidance, mentorship, and support as needed. - Delegate tasks effectively, monitor team performance, and foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment. 

 Qualifications - Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related field Master's degree preferred. - Minimum of 12 years of experience in housing construction or related field, with demonstrated expertise in project management and structural design. - Proficiency in engineering software such as AutoCAD, Revit, and structural analysis tools. - Strong understanding of building codes, regulations, and industry best practices. - Excellent communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills. - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Key Skills: High Rise Building,Structural Analysis,Residential Projects,Site Management,Project Management,Hotel Projects,Civil Engineering,Building Construction

title: Civil Site Engineer / Computer operator
description:
1- Site Civil Engineer 
 We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Site Civil Engineer specializing in the construction and execution of Overhead Tanks (OHT) . In this role, you will oversee day-to-day site operations, ensure structural integrity and compliance with design specifications, and utilize advanced drafting tools ( AutoCAD MS office , Excel , Word and CATIA ) for on-site technical adjustments, formwork detailing, and structural layout coordination. Key Responsibilities Site Execution & Supervision: Manage the end-to-end construction of Overhead Water Tanks (OHT), including foundation work, staging/column erection, staging bracings, and container (dome/conical bottom) casting. Technical Drafting & Modeling: Utilize AutoCAD MS office , Excel to review, modify, and interpret structural and architectural drawings on-site. Leverage CATIA for advanced 3D modeling of complex structural components, precast elements, or intricate formwork configurations. Surveying & Layout: Perform precise site leveling, alignment, and coordinate checks using standard surveying instruments to ensure exact positioning of tank structures. Quality Control & Testing: Conduct rigorous quality checks for raw materials (concrete, steel), monitor slump tests, cube tests, and oversee hydrostatic water-retaining tests for the OHT. Safety & Compliance: Enforce strict health and safety (HSE) protocols on site, particularly concerning high-altitude work, scaffolding, and heavy lifting operations. Progress Reporting: Maintain daily site logs, track material consumption, and coordinate closely with project managers and contractors to meet project timelines. Candidate Requirements & Qualifications Education: Bachelors Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering. Experience: 2 to 6 years of hands-on experience in site execution, specifically focusing on water-retaining structures, reservoirs, or Overhead Tanks (OHT). Software Proficiency: Strong expertise in AutoCAD for 2D construction drawings and detailing. Familiarity with CATIA for advanced modeling or specialized structural detailing. Site Skills: Proficient in site surveying, leveling, reading complex structural blueprints, and managing local labor teams. Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, leadership, and effective communication skills to handle on-site challenges swiftly. 
 2- Computer Operator 
 We are looking for a Computer Operator for our Jabalpur office who will be responsible for day-to-day computer operations, data entry, documentation, record management, and office coordination. Key Responsibilities: Handle daily computer operations and office documentation. Perform accurate data entry and maintain company records. Prepare and maintain documents, reports, letters, and spreadsheets. Work efficiently on Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint . Maintain digital and physical records and organize office files. Prepare Excel reports and update daily data as required. Manage printing, scanning, photocopying, and document filing. Coordinate with the site and office team for required documentation. Handle emails and basic internet-based office work. Ensure accuracy and timely completion of assigned administrative tasks. Candidate Requirements: Minimum 12th pass; graduate preferred. Good knowledge of MS Office, especially MS Excel and MS Word . Good typing and data-entry skills. Basic knowledge of email and internet applications. Good communication and organizational skills. Freshers with good computer knowledge can also apply.

Key Skills: Civil Engineering,CATIA,Surveying & Leveling,MS Excel,Record Management,AutoCAD,Site Supervision,Site Execution
